name: pasr-realagent-pilot
status: 50 source-grounded tasks over 10 pinned public Python repos. Identifiers grepped from the resolved checkouts; run_eval records each repo's resolved commit into resolved_commits.json / matrix.jsonl.
notes: Arms: native_search / broad (58k source-first) / pasr / pasr_fallback. The model answers each task from ONLY the arm's context, then a judge scores it against answer_keywords; critical_source_hit is required. Keyword answers were verified present in critical_source at the pinned commit.
